at 0 command content:oblivion.esm:02466e GetStage
at 0 command dynamic:player:0000000000000001 GetDead

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local frame=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frame=frame+1
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during escort departure')
 if frame==5 then print('Escort departure ready') end
 for _,id in ipairs({{0x32a16,0x32a17,0x32a18}}) do
  local actor=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  if actor and actor:isValid() then
   if id==0x32a18 and actor.position.y>5700 then print('Emperor cleared ambush door') end
   if frame%15==0 then print('Escort departure actor '..id..' pos='..tostring(actor.position)) end
  end
 end
 if frame%15==0 then print('Escort departure Player '..tostring(self.position)) end
end}}}}
